items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. One notable critical flaw is CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap), a template engine injection vulnerability.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (BlockStrap)
items.summary: A critical template engine injection flaw (BlockStrap) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Although fixed in APSB26-153, new installations may require a manual patch.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability (PolyShell)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.3), also known as PolyShell, allows unrestricted file upload with dangerous types, leading to arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento. It has been actively exploited in the wild since at least July 2025 and was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 27, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This emergency security update resolves a critical vulnerability, CVE-2026-75650, in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this vulnerability being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (StyleSmuggler) under active attack
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability (CVSS 10.0), dubbed 'StyleSmuggler', in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source was actively exploited as a zero-day. Attackers inject malicious PHP code through the template engine's 'styles' property.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation, including the critical CVE-2026-71362.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability allowing unauthenticated customer account takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions, hijack accounts, and access private data. Exploitation attempts were observed shortly after its public disclosure.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass, including the unrestricted file upload vulnerability CVE-2026-48356.
